clauses.source: (1) 009: 'if the user's claimed terms are incorrect ... do not provide a referral link tool'. (2) 002: 'Each credit card type has its own referral bonus and eligibility requirements'. (3) So terms are correct only if they match the requested card's own document.

clauses.clause: A customer who cited none has no discrepancy
clauses.source: 009: 'If the customer cites terms that do not match ... clarify the discrepancy'. The clarification is conditioned on terms being cited.

ask_verification.why: The 2-of-4 rule is stated, and verification is needed because the auto-reject check reads referral history.

clauses.clause: verify at this point
clauses.source: (1) 009 withholds the tool on 'reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected'. (2) 002 says to track the timing of recent bonuses. (3) Policy lists 'referral history' among data that needs verification.

lookup_user.why: The policy says to call the read tools, and the three tool descriptions match the three kinds of identifier.

check_verification.why: The 2-of-4 match, the ban on leaking information and the ban on accessing records are each stated in the policy.

get_verification_time.why: The get_current_time tool description names verification logging.

log_verification.why: The policy requires logging, and the tool description defines the fields and the MM/DD/YYYY format.

get_referrals.why: 002 says to track the timing of recent bonuses, and get_referrals_by_user reads the user's referrals.

check_auto_reject.why: The count of COMPLETE referrals in the 7 days before now, across all cards, follows from 009, 002, 020 and 001.

clauses.clause: Count COMPLETE referrals across all card types in the window from 7 days before now to now; 2 or more means denied
clauses.source: (1) 009: 'at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window; the third and subsequent referrals in that window are automatically denied'. (2) 001: COMPLETE means 'met the criteria to get the referral bonus'. (3) 002: the limit is across all card types and uses exact timestamps. (4) 020: 'already had 2 referrals complete in the past week'.

explain_auto_reject.why: 002 says to wait until under the cap, and 009 forbids giving the tool or transferring.

give_link_tool.why: 009 states the tool, its arguments, that the customer runs it and the three pre-conditions.

clauses.clause: card_name as titled in its referral program document
clauses.source: 009: 'the exact card name (for example, 'Gold Rewards Card')'. Each card document's title gives that card's exact name.

customer_generates_link.why: 009 and the get_referral_link description define the call.

handle_tool_error.why: The error replies in the tool descriptions and 009's documented name and parameters support each action.

clauses.clause: check tool name and arguments, then give it again
clauses.source: give_discoverable_user_tool can return 'Unknown discoverable tool' and 'Unexpected parameter'. 009 gives the signature `get_referral_link(user_id: str, card_name: str)`.

reiterate_terms.why: 009 says to reiterate the terms and states the NO_PROGRESS status, 002 gives the window rule and 001 gives the ERROR action.

clauses.clause: If a referral record later shows ERROR, tell the customer to retry later
clauses.source: 001: 'ERROR: Retry later or escalate internally if the condition persists'. Retrying later is the first action, and escalation applies only if the condition persists.

next_card.why: 002 says each card has its own terms, the policy says not to verify twice, and 009 forbids transfer for failed checks.

R1.why: 009 states the three conditions and the ban on transfer; the letter, email or flyer case falls under 'no referral program is documented'.

R2.why: 042 only says which reason code to choose when a transfer happens, while 009 names this case itself and forbids a transfer.

R5.why: The bonus, spend, days and cap come from EcoCard 011, and calling any other amount incorrect follows from it.

R10.why: Stated in Business Gold 010, and the rule notes the missing unit.

R13.why: Silver Zoom 011 states the figures and end date, and other figures are incorrect for this card.

R14.why: 001 states both the REJECTED and the ERROR actions.
